title: Can I BEAT Passant?
summary: First Passant video (demo): tutorial then stage 1 (two rounds + one boss). Tutorial: you always start with a king; five victory conditions (check the enemy six turns in a row; checkmate; take all non-king pieces; score +5 for two turns; 20 more turns without a capture at -$2 reward); 3 undos per match; pawns promote to queen; badges change rules; starting badge gives a Courtisan (stops an adjacent enemy piece from moving and attacking); coins are one-use (queen coin). Wins round 1 (+$4), buys a queen; round 2 challenging (enemy 2 bishops, rook, 3 pawns; standard was 2B, N, P) +$6; boss defeated by checkmate +$8. Stage 1 complete.
rules: Passant: a chess roguelike (demo / full release). You play White on an 8x8 board with a small purchasable army against the AI's preset enemy army each round.
Each round you may choose Standard, Challenging (harder enemy army, better reward), or Skip.
Round win: checkmate the enemy king OR deliver six checks (a check counter).
Rewards: money ($) per round (+ bonuses, e.g. capturing some pieces pays $1).
SHOP between rounds: buy pieces (e.g. Bishop, Rook, Knight, Empress = rook+knight, Courtisan, Amazon = queen+knight), coins and badges; Re-roll; Next Stage.

Coins are one-shot consumables used on the board: Queen coin (promote a pawn of your choice to a queen), Pawn coin, Demotion coin (demote an enemy piece to a weaker one), Money coin (sell one of your pieces for half its value, rounded down).

Badges are passive perks, e.g. Coin Machine (receive a demotion coin at the start of each round), Window Shopper (rerolls cost $1), 'mark one square; if a friendly piece moves there receive a random coin', 'give a random piece on your setup board a special modifier'.
Boss rounds carry modifiers (e.g. Fischer Random start) and cost/award more.
AI difficulty setting: Standard / Challenging / Grandmaster.
You always start with a king (moves/attacks one square).
Five ways to win a round: check the enemy six turns in a row; checkmate; take all non-king pieces; score +5 for two turns; survive 20 more turns without a capture (reward -$2).
Courtisan: stops an enemy piece on a surrounding square from moving and attacking.

Shop: badges (e.g. +$3 reward at end of each round; Rooks to Empresses - rooks upgrade to empresses at round start but become unstable), coins (Pawn coin, Demote-to-pawn coin - kings and badge pieces excluded, Queen coin), pieces (queen etc.).
Rounds: Standard vs Challenging (harder enemy, more money) or Skip (reward but no money/shop).
win_condition: Win rounds by any of the five victory conditions; clear stage 1 (2 rounds + boss).
